description: Front A (broad catalog), generic composition scenario, O11 lane (same design as the homonymous ODC job, independent result). (1) A NEW server action returns outputs of different types and resets them to the neutral values of each type, PRESERVING two excluded outputs (KeptText, KeptCount), which only copy the inputs: a seed Assign and then a reset Assign with one assignment per non-excluded output. Reset values measured here: Text "", Integer/Long Integer/Decimal/Currency 0, Boolean False, Date and Date Time NullDate(), Time #00:00:00#, Identifier NullIdentifier(), record/structure/lists copied from a never-assigned local variable of the same type. (2) The CALL of that action is inserted into a BRANCH of an If of an INHERITED action (FalseTarget of the only If of Customer_AddCredit, which came from job:smoke-data-logic), before the only raise node of that branch: the node is created, the output of the new node is first linked to the successor and only then is the connector of the If repointed. (3) Reads: the typed inventory of the new action (dump), the If and the new node before/after, and usages of the new action. Headless: proves the model and the Verify, not the value at run time.
